name: glm-models
title: GLM Models
description: Use Z.ai / BigModel GLM models inside Raycast AI Chat, Quick AI and AI Commands
author: paulgit

commands.name: check-setup
commands.title: Check Setup
commands.description: Validate your API key and platform settings against the Z.ai API

commands.name: refresh-models
commands.title: Refresh Models
commands.description: Re-fetch the list of GLM models available to your account

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: API key from the platform you pick below. Create one at z.ai → API Keys, or open.bigmodel.cn → API Keys. Keys from the two platforms are not interchangeable.

preferences.name: platform
preferences.title: Platform
preferences.description: Where your API key was created. Z.ai and BigModel are separate platforms with separate keys — pick the one matching your key. GLM Coding Plan and Team Plan keys must use a GLM Coding Plan option.

preferences.name: customBaseUrl
preferences.title: Custom Base URL
preferences.description: HTTPS OpenAI-compatible base URL, used when Platform is set to Custom (e.g. https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/)

preferences.name: extraModels
preferences.title: Extra Models
preferences.description: Optional comma-separated model IDs to always include in the model list
